Questions.Question: How do I contact Ark Fiduciaire in Geneva?
Questions.Answer: You can call +41 22 512 50 50, email info@ark-fid.ch, use the form on this page or message us on WhatsApp.

Questions.Question: How do I book a call with the team?
Questions.Answer: Use the "Book a call" button on this page, which suits a planned conversation with our team. You can also call us directly to speak with the team.

Questions.Question: Can I message you on WhatsApp?
Questions.Answer: Yes, WhatsApp works for quick questions and quick answers.

Questions.Question: Where is your office?
Questions.Answer: Our office is at 26 Boulevard Georges Favon, 1204 Geneva, Switzerland.

Questions.Question: Which languages can you answer in?
Questions.Answer: Our advisers speak French, English and German. Depending on the team members and the file, we also work in Spanish, Portuguese or Italian.
